name: chips
gotchas: As of Angular Material 17, the removable/editable chip APIs live on `mat-chip-grid`/`MatChipGrid` (paired with `matChipInputFor`) — `mat-chip-list` still exists but only supports the older, non-input-integrated selection use case.

A chip's remove icon needs an explicit `(removed)` handler wired to actually delete the item from your data array — `matChipRemove` only renders the affordance and emits the event, it does not remove anything itself.

Chips inside a `mat-chip-grid` each participate in the surrounding form's tab order as individual focusable cells — an unbounded number of chips can noticeably lengthen keyboard navigation through a form.
